title: Order the parallel-feature run
intro: Lesson 5's exact workflow for landing three features at once — put it in order.
prompt: Drag into order, first step on top.

steps.text: Add and commit any pending changes — start from a clean tree
mkdir .trees, then git worktree add .trees/<feature> per feature
Open a terminal in each worktree; launch a Claude Code session in each
Assign each session its feature; let them work in parallel
Add and commit the changes inside each worktree; close the sessions
In the main terminal: have Claude merge all .trees worktrees into main and fix conflicts

debrief: Clean first, split second, parallelize third, commit per-tree, merge last. The two steps that get skipped in practice bite hardest: an uncommitted starting tree contaminates every worktree with the same dirt, and forgetting to commit inside a worktree means the merge silently misses that feature. The merge is the only serial step — delegating it to Claude is fine; skipping the review of it is not.
